name: verbatim-compaction
description: Verbatim compaction for Claude Code: stale tool output pruned by local rules and one session fork; no summary, no third-party API.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum characters saved, as a share of the transcript's tool-result characters, required to replace history; below it the built-in summary runs.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages never touched.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters kept from a truncated tool result.

truncateTailChars.title: Truncated tool result tail
truncateTailChars.description: Characters also kept from the end of a test/build/deploy-like result, or to hold a token quoted later.

staleAfterMessages.title: Stale after messages
staleAfterMessages.description: Read and Bash file-read results older than this many messages are truncated.

pinReferenced.title: Pin referenced results
pinReferenced.description: Never drop a result whose introduced tokens (shas, tickets, paths...) are quoted later.

stripMcpFurniture.title: Strip MCP furniture
stripMcpFurniture.description: Remove self links, avatars, feature flags and similar JSON furniture from kept MCP results.

maxCandidates.title: Maximum Claude candidates
maxCandidates.description: Most tool calls listed for the Claude fork, largest outputs first.

useClaudeScorer.title: Use Claude scorer
useClaudeScorer.description: Ask one tool-less fork of the session about calls the rules leave undecided. Off: rules only, no model call.

claudeTimeoutMs.title: Claude scorer timeout (ms)
claudeTimeoutMs.description: How long the fork may take; past it the rules alone decide. Clamped to [500, 9000] ms, under the ten seconds the engine's test kit allows (not declared for live hooks).
